senses.gloss: m. (חָלַף) sharp knife, slaughtering-knife.—Pl. חַלִּיפוֹת.—בית הח׳ the place in the Temple where the slaughtering knives were kept.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:7">Midd. IV, 7</cite> (Talm. ed. <he>פת …</he>, corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yoma 36a:2">Yoma 36ᵃ</cite> <he>מן בית הח׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>מן הח׳</he>) inside of the knives’ cell.
